comment: Mechanisms the estate has built and that must have a live caller. GOV-015 refuses a mechanism with no caller (AGENTS.md section 9, R2). Seeded 2026-11-11 with the three built-but-uncalled mechanisms named in docs/diagnoses/2026-11-11-reactive-wakeup-signaling-gap.md, plus the worker queue whose consumer lifecycle had zero callers for 13 days.

mechanisms.why: incident-loop.py calls only push_task. Measured 2026-11-11: 56 tasks, 0 ever claimed, oldest 13.2 days. The consumer lifecycle must be reached by the incident squad or this mechanism is dead weight.
The durable per-agent inbox (NATS JetStream, pull_subscribe) had 0 callers when the reactive-wakeup gap was diagnosed.
The blocking primitive that replaces polling. It is the join the squad uses to wake on a real work event instead of a loop.
